sources.title: Robotail UCAT C42 User Manual
sources.method: Web text review; search copy crawled on the check date
facts: The specifications list clumping litter with grain length under 15 mm.
The replacing-litter section recommends a tofu and cassava blend and describes removal of the litter cleaning board after emptying.
The control panel section identifies a flatten function. Safety instructions say to keep hands away while rotating and to avoid forcing a cat into the box.

sources.title: Robotail UCAT C42 illustrated manufacturer manual
sources.method: Downloaded and visually inspected the original PDF, rendered PDF page 7, printed page 06
facts: Replacing litter, step 6, shows where the maximum fill level is indicated and directs owners to add fresh litter below it.
